contacto.cierre: Looking for someone who turns manual processes into automated workflows and data into decisions? Let’s talk.

perfil: Systems Engineering student in my tenth semester at Universidad César Vallejo (top 20% of my class), with experience in process automation, enterprise systems integration and digital transformation.
I have built solutions with n8n, Power Automate, Python and Odoo 17/18 that streamline sales, warehouse, finance and HR operations. I also have experience in data analysis and Power BI dashboards.
I currently design and implement distributed Odoo 18 architectures for retail companies. My focus is on improving operational efficiency with scalable, results-oriented technology solutions.

ficha.valor: Data & automation: ETL pipelines, Power BI and n8n / Power Automate workflows

proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: A central VPS and a local PostgreSQL database at each site, kept in sync through the API / JSON-RPC. A centralized sync module manages, for each site, the API connection, remote warehouse, price list and point of sale, so new stores can be rolled out in a standardized way.

Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Accounting and Expenses dashboards with per-site indicators: total sales, electronic receipts, average ticket, credit notes and purchases by supplier. They give management a consolidated view of every store.

Custom Python modules on Odoo for SUNAT electronic invoicing through an OSE, synchronization of catalog, prices and stock across sites with event traceability, and settlement reports by payment method.

Integration and data transformation (ETL) workflows connecting Odoo 17, WooCommerce and BioTime to sync stock, orders and attendance, reducing manual work. Includes monitoring, logs and alerts for critical automations.
AS-IS / TO-BE modeling in BPMN for sales, warehouse, finance and HR, plus functional support for the Odoo 17 rollout: configuration, UAT and documentation.

logros: Designed and implemented a distributed multi-site architecture on Odoo 18 (a central VPS and a local PostgreSQL database per site) synchronized through the API / JSON-RPC.
Developed custom Python modules on Odoo for SUNAT electronic invoicing through an OSE, catalog and stock synchronization across sites, and settlement reports by payment method.
Implemented a centralized sync module on the VPS that manages, for each site, the API connection, remote warehouse, price list and point of sale, allowing the solution to scale to new stores.
Built executive dashboards (Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Accounting and Expenses) with per-site indicators: total sales, electronic receipts, average ticket, credit notes and purchases by supplier.
Synchronized catalogs and price lists between headquarters and each store through the API, with event traceability to keep data consistent.
Standardized the deployment and remote management of sites with Debian, PostgreSQL, Nginx and Tailscale, replicated across several retail companies.
Automated business processes with n8n, Power Automate (with SharePoint) and Python, reducing manual tasks and operating times.
Integrated systems through APIs (Odoo 17, WooCommerce, BioTime), keeping stock, orders, attendance and other critical data in sync.
Modeled and redesigned processes (AS-IS / TO-BE, BPMN) for sales, warehouse, finance and HR.
Built executive dashboards in Power BI, ensuring data consistency and traceability.
Provided functional support for the Odoo 17 rollout: configuration, UAT and documentation.
Set up monitoring, logs and alerts for critical automations; managed user access and backups.
Trained users, wrote technical manuals and ran digital pilots.
Administered and maintained the corporate WordPress website, including hosting, domains and SSL.
Developed new features, forms, landing pages and responsive design (UX/UI).
Integrated the website with internal systems (Sistema PROGRESS).
Improved technical SEO, page speed, security and technical documentation, with version control in Git.
Designed responsive web pages with Elementor and WordPress for mobile, tablet and desktop.
